Country of Origin: New Zealand
The milk from which this product is manufactured is produced and processed entirely in New Zealand.

The material is imported into the United States through the port of Tacoma, Washington, and is repacked without further processing at our Salem, Oregon facility. Repacking does not constitute a substantial transformation and does not change the country of origin declared above.

This statement applies to all lots supplied under the referenced purchase agreement unless a superseding statement is issued. Lot-specific documentation, including the manufacturer's certificate of analysis, is retained for a period of not less than two years and is available on request.
